test_detail.reading_desc: In this test, you will test your reading and comprehension skills. Each question has 4 options. Choose the correct answer. Results are shown immediately.
test_detail.listening_desc: In this test, you will test your listening comprehension skills (currently in text form). Each question has 4 options. Results are shown immediately.

mock_guide.card3_desc: Your CEFR level (A1–C1) is determined based on results.
mock_guide.card4_desc: All questions test your grammar knowledge.
mock_guide.rule1: Each question has only one correct answer
mock_guide.rule2: You can skip questions and come back to them
mock_guide.rule3: The test ends automatically when time runs out
mock_guide.rule4: You can view the result only once
mock_guide.payment_info: Send the payment receipt (screenshot) to @CEFRdigitalbot. After admin confirmation, you can start the test.
